headline: Brazil's Prosecutor General Seeks Supreme Court Freeze on Betting Lawsuits
summary: Prosecutor General Paulo Gonet asked Brazil's Supreme Federal Court to suspend all lower-court lawsuits opposing the federal ban on online betting platforms until a final ruling.
why: Brazil is one of the largest emerging markets for online sports betting and gaming, where regulatory clarity determines billions in licensing and tax revenues.

impacts.name: Brazil Online Gaming Sector
impacts.why: The legal pause halts operators' court challenges while the Supreme Court deliberates the federal ban.
